verses.original: Φοβηθῶμεν οὖν μή‿ ποτε καταλειπομένης ἐπαγγελίας εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσιν αὐτοῦ δοκῇ τις ἐξ ὑμῶν ὑστερηκέναι
verses.transliteration: Phobēthōmen oun mē pote kataleipomenēs epangelias eiselthein eis tēn katapausin autou dokē tis ex hymōn hysterēkenai
verses.literal: Therefore while the promise of entering . . . His rest still stands let us be careful that none . . . . . . of you be deemed to have fallen short of it
verses.literalPt: Temamos, portanto, que, sendo-nos feita uma promessa de entrarmos no seu descanso, não haja algum de vós, porventura, que pareça ter falhado.

verses.original: καὶ γάρ ἐσμεν εὐηγγελισμένοι καθάπερ κἀκεῖνοι ἀλλ’ οὐκ ὠφέλησεν ὁ λόγος τῆς ἀκοῆς ἐκείνους μὴ συγκεκερασμένους τῇ πίστει τοῖς ἀκούσασιν
verses.transliteration: kai gar esmen euēngelismenoi kathaper kakeinoi all’ ouk ōphelēsen ho logos tēs akoēs ekeinous mē synkekerasmenous tē pistei tois akousasin
verses.literal: For we also received the good news just as they did but the message they heard was of no value to them since they did not share the faith of those who comprehended it
verses.literalPt: Pois, na verdade, a nós nos tem sido evangelizado, como a eles; mas a palavra da mensagem não lhes aproveitou, não sendo unida com a fé naqueles que a ouviram.

verses.original: Εἰσερχόμεθα γὰρ εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσιν οἱ πιστεύσαντες καθὼς εἴρηκεν Ὡς ὤμοσα ἐν τῇ ὀργῇ μου Εἰ εἰσελεύσονται εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσίν μου Καίτοι τῶν ἔργων ἀπὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου γενηθέντων
verses.transliteration: Eiserchometha gar eis tēn katapausin hoi pisteusantes kathōs eirēken Hōs ōmosa en tē orgē mou Ei eiseleusontai eis tēn katapausin mou Kaitoi tōn ergōn apo katabolēs kosmou genēthentōn
verses.literal: Now we who have believed enter . . . that rest As for the others, it is just as God has said So I swore on oath in My anger They shall never enter . . . My rest And yet His works have been finished since the foundation of the world
verses.literalPt: Pois nós, que cremos, entramos no descanso, assim como ele tem dito: Assim, jurei na minha ira: não entrarão no meu descanso, embora fossem completadas as obras desde a fundação do mundo.

verses.original: εἴρηκεν γάρ που περὶ τῆς ἑβδόμης οὕτως Καὶ κατέπαυσεν ὁ Θεὸς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἔργων αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: eirēken gar pou peri tēs hebdomēs houtōs Kai katepausen ho Theos en tē hēmera tē hebdomē apo pantōn tōn ergōn autou
verses.literal: For somewhere He has spoken about the seventh day in this manner And on the seventh day God rested from all His works
verses.literalPt: Pois, em certo lugar, disse assim acerca do dia sétimo: E descansou Deus, no dia sétimo, de todas as suas obras.

verses.original: καὶ ἐν τούτῳ πάλιν Εἰ εἰσελεύσονται εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσίν μου
verses.transliteration: kai en toutō palin Ei eiseleusontai eis tēn katapausin mou
verses.literal: And again as He says in the passage above They shall never enter . . . My rest
verses.literalPt: E outra vez neste lugar: Não entrarão no meu descanso.

verses.original: Ἐπεὶ οὖν ἀπολείπεται τινὰς εἰσελθεῖν εἰς αὐτήν καὶ οἱ πρότερον εὐαγγελισθέντες οὐκ εἰσῆλθον δι’ ἀπείθειαν
verses.transliteration: Epei oun apoleipetai tinas eiselthein eis autēn kai hoi proteron euangelisthentes ouk eisēlthon di’ apeitheian
verses.literal: Since then it remains for some to enter . . . His rest and since those who formerly heard the good news did not enter because of their disobedience
verses.literalPt: Visto, portanto, que resta que alguns entrem nele e que os que foram anteriormente evangelizados não entraram, por causa da desobediência,

verses.original: πάλιν τινὰ ὁρίζει ἡμέραν Σήμερον ἐν Δαυὶδ λέγων μετὰ τοσοῦτον χρόνον καθὼς προείρηται Σήμερον ἐὰν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ ἀκούσητε μὴ σκληρύνητε τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: palin tina horizei hēmeran Sēmeron en Dauid legōn meta tosouton chronon kathōs proeirētai Sēmeron ean tēs phōnēs autou akousēte mē sklērynēte tas kardias hymōn
verses.literal: God again designated a certain day as Today when a long time later He spoke through David as was just stated Today if you hear His voice do not harden your hearts
verses.literalPt: outra vez determina um certo dia, hoje, dizendo por Davi, depois de tanto tempo (como antes se disse): Hoje, se ouvirdes a sua voz, não endureçais os vossos corações.

verses.original: Εἰ γὰρ αὐτοὺς Ἰησοῦς κατέπαυσεν οὐκ ἂν περὶ ἄλλης ἐλάλει μετὰ ταῦτα ἡμέρας
verses.transliteration: Ei gar autous Iēsous katepausen ouk an peri allēs elalei meta tauta hēmeras
verses.literal: For if Joshua had given them rest . . . God would not have spoken later . . . about another day
verses.literalPt: Pois, se Josué lhes houvesse dado descanso, não teria, depois, falado de outro dia.

verses.original: ἄρα ἀπολείπεται σαββατισμὸς τῷ λαῷ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: ara apoleipetai sabbatismos tō laō tou Theou
verses.literal: There remains then a Sabbath rest for the people of God
verses.literalPt: Portanto, resta um sabatismo para o povo de Deus.

verses.original: ὁ γὰρ εἰσελθὼν εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσιν αὐτοῦ καὶ αὐτὸς κατέπαυσεν ἀπὸ τῶν ἔργων αὐτοῦ ὥσπερ ἀπὸ τῶν ἰδίων ὁ Θεός
verses.transliteration: ho gar eiselthōn eis tēn katapausin autou kai autos katepausen apo tōn ergōn autou hōsper apo tōn idiōn ho Theos
verses.literal: For whoever enters . . . God’s rest also rests from his own work just as God did from His . . .
verses.literalPt: Pois aquele que entrou no descanso dele, este também descansou das suas obras, assim como Deus das suas.

verses.original: Σπουδάσωμεν οὖν εἰσελθεῖν εἰς ἐκείνην τὴν κατάπαυσιν ἵνα μὴ ἐν τῷ αὐτῷ τις ὑποδείγματι πέσῃ τῆς ἀπειθείας
verses.transliteration: Spoudasōmen oun eiselthein eis ekeinēn tēn katapausin hina mē en tō autō tis hypodeigmati pesē tēs apeitheias
verses.literal: Let us, therefore, make every effort . . . to enter . . . that rest so that no one will fall by following the same pattern of disobedience
verses.literalPt: Portanto, esforcemo-nos por entrar naquele descanso, a fim de que ninguém caia segundo o mesmo exemplo de desobediência.

verses.original: Ζῶν γὰρ ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ ἐνεργὴς καὶ τομώτερος ὑπὲρ πᾶσαν μάχαιραν δίστομον καὶ διϊκνούμενος ἄχρι μερισμοῦ ψυχῆς καὶ πνεύματος ἁρμῶν τε καὶ μυελῶν καὶ κριτικὸς ἐνθυμήσεων καὶ ἐννοιῶν καρδίας
verses.transliteration: Zōn gar ho logos tou Theou kai energēs kai tomōteros hyper pasan machairan distomon kai diiknoumenos achri merismou psychēs kai pneumatos harmōn te kai myelōn kai kritikos enthymēseōn kai ennoiōn kardias
verses.literal: For the word of God is living and active Sharper than any double-edged sword it pierces even to dividing soul and spirit joints and marrow It judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart
verses.literalPt: Pois a palavra de Deus é viva, e eficaz, e mais cortante que qualquer espada de dois gumes, e que penetra até a divisão de alma e espírito, e de juntas e medulas, e pronta para discernir as disposições e pensamentos do coração.

verses.original: καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν κτίσις ἀφανὴς ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ πάντα δὲ γυμνὰ καὶ τετραχηλισμένα τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτοῦ πρὸς ὃν ἡμῖν ὁ λόγος
verses.transliteration: kai ouk estin ktisis aphanēs enōpion autou panta de gymna kai tetrachēlismena tois ophthalmois autou pros hon hēmin ho logos
verses.literal: Nothing in all creation is hidden from God’s sight . . . everything is uncovered and exposed before the eyes of Him to whom we must give account
verses.literalPt: Não há criatura que não seja manifesta diante dele, mas todas as coisas estão nuas e descobertas aos olhos daquele a quem havemos de dar contas.

verses.original: Ἔχοντες οὖν ἀρχιερέα μέγαν διεληλυθότα τοὺς οὐρανούς Ἰησοῦν τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ κρατῶμεν τῆς ὁμολογίας
verses.transliteration: Echontes oun archierea megan dielēlythota tous ouranous Iēsoun ton Huion tou Theou kratōmen tēs homologias
verses.literal: Therefore since we have a great high priest who has passed through the heavens Jesus the Son of God let us hold firmly to what we profess
verses.literalPt: Tendo, portanto, um grande sumo sacerdote que penetrou os céus, a saber, Jesus, Filho de Deus, guardemos firmes a nossa confissão.

verses.original: οὐ γὰρ ἔχομεν ἀρχιερέα μὴ δυνάμενον συμπαθῆσαι ταῖς ἀσθενείαις ἡμῶν πεπειρασμένον δὲ κατὰ πάντα καθ’ ὁμοιότητα χωρὶς ἁμαρτίας
verses.transliteration: ou gar echomen archierea mē dynamenon sympathēsai tais astheneiais hēmōn pepeirasmenon de kata panta kath’ homoiotēta chōris hamartias
verses.literal: For we do not have a high priest who is unable to sympathize with our weaknesses but we have one who was tempted in every way that we are yet was without sin
verses.literalPt: Pois não temos um sumo sacerdote que não possa compadecer-se das nossas enfermidades, mas que tem sido tentado em todas as coisas, à nossa semelhança, mas sem pecado.

verses.original: προσερχώμεθα οὖν μετὰ παρρησίας τῷ θρόνῳ τῆς χάριτος ἵνα λάβωμεν ἔλεος καὶ χάριν εὕρωμεν εἰς εὔκαιρον βοήθειαν
verses.transliteration: proserchōmetha oun meta parrēsias tō thronō tēs charitos hina labōmen eleos kai charin heurōmen eis eukairon boētheian
verses.literal: Let us then approach the throne of grace with confidence so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need
verses.literalPt: Cheguemo-nos, portanto, com confiança, ao trono da graça, para que recebamos misericórdia e achemos graça, a fim de sermos socorridos em tempo oportuno.
